period_note: Solo (bank-only) Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account from National Bank's Q3-2024 unaudited financial statements; plain 'Balance Sheet (Un-audited)'/'Profit and Loss Account (Un-audited)' sections used (Solo+OBU basis). Comparative column (31 Dec 2023) reproduces the known FY2023 equity of 23189.24m exactly. Equity fell further to 5469.19m (Sep 2024) from 12390.74m (Jun 2024) -- STILL POSITIVE but now very thin, less than a quarter of the paid-up capital. The Statement of Changes in Equity in this filing shows a 'Prior year's adjustment' of +152.80m added to opening retained earnings, which reconciles the small (~154m) gap between the discrete Q3 loss (-7075.78m) and the quarter's actual equity decline (-6921.55m). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2024 (9-month figures; first of four P&L columns). RESTATEMENT FOUND: this dataset's own later 2025_Q3 filing's comparative column for the same Jan-Sep 2024 period shows Net Profit after taxation of -13,605,707,399 (Taka), materially different from -17,873,515,228 as reported contemporaneously here in the bank's own Q3-2024 filing -- a difference of exactly 4,267,807,829, which equals a tax credit shown in the 2025_Q3 filing's Jan-Jun-2024 comparative deferred-tax line. Per this dataset's standing rule (prefer the contemporaneous figure; record but do not silently apply a later restatement), the -17,873.52m figure from this bank's own Q3-2024 report is used and preferred here; the divergence is also recorded in sources.json. Cross-check against press coverage: The Business Standard (30 Oct 2024, reporting on this same disclosure) cited a CONSOLIDATED nine-month loss of 'Tk1,768 crore' (17,680m) and consolidated EPS of -5.49, both close to but not identical to this SOLO filing's -17,873.52m / -5.55 -- consistent with an expected small solo-vs-consolidated gap, not a data error. As in prior quarters, 'Total operating income' and 'Profit before provision' print without their negative sign despite being losses; corrected via the identity chain and cross-checked against the explicitly-parenthesized 'Profit before taxes' and 'Net Profit after taxation' lines (identical, confirming zero provision and zero tax this period). Source PDF was image-only; text obtained via OCR (tesseract, 300dpi).
